item.title: A train-sized tunnel is now carrying electricity under South London
item.description:
📝 A train-sized tunnel is now carrying electricity under South London Published on 16th December 2025 by Ian Mansfield in London News Electricity has started flowing through a deep-level tube train sized tunnel running through South London. 5km across seven South London boroughs from Wimbledon to Hurst. 5km) National Grid – London Power Tunnels 2 The current London Power Tunnels project through South London follows the completion in 2018 of the first phase – a seven-year, £1 billion project to construct 32km of tunnels and two new substations to rewire the network in North London.
🔗 Read more: https://www.ianvisits.co.uk/articles/a-train-sized-tunnel-is-now-carrying-electricity-under-south-london-86221/
